name: users/models.py
summary: Defines the core user domain models including a custom user entity, its manager, and an associated profile model.
purpose: Provides the foundational data layer for user authentication and identity management, separating authentication concerns from extended user profile attributes to support a clean, modular user subsystem.
responsibilities: Define the custom User model extending Django's AbstractUser
Encapsulate user and superuser creation logic via CustomUserManager
Store extended user attributes in a separate Profile model
Establish database relationships, constraints, and schema for user data
Serve as the primary persistence contract for the users bounded context
inputs: User registration and authentication data (e.g., email, password, profile fields)
ORM queries and manager method invocations from services and admin layers
outputs: QuerySets for user lookups, filtering, and relationships
architecture_notes: Implements Django's custom user model pattern with AbstractUser to future-proof against evolving identity requirements. Separates authentication identity (User) from auxiliary profile data (Profile) to adhere to the Single Responsibility Principle. The CustomUserManager centralizes object creation logic and enforces invariant rules. Located in a dedicated 'users' app within a modular backend structure, promoting bounded context separation. Adjacent serializers and services indicate a layered architecture (Model -> Service -> Serializer -> Admin) with clear dependency direction inward toward the models.
improvements: Add explicit type hints to CustomUserManager methods and model fields for better static analysis and developer experience
Define database indexes on frequently queried fields (e.g., email, username) to optimize authentication and lookup performance
Add __str__ representations and Meta ordering to User and Profile models for improved debugging and API consistency
Implement model-level validation (clean methods or field validators) for business rules such as email normalization
Ensure the Profile model references settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL using a string lazy reference to prevent circular imports and improve app reusability
Add verbose_name and verbose_name_plural Meta options to enhance the Django admin interface readability
